ただし、同法第33条第１項の再生手続開始の決定を受け、その決定に係る同法第174条第１項の再生計画認可の決定が確定している場合は、この限りでない。

ただし、同法第41条第１項の更生手続開始の決定を受け、その決定に係る同法第199条第１項の更生計画の認可の決定がある場合は、この限りでない。

items.text_ja: 和歌山県暴力団排除条例（平成23年和歌山県条例第23号）第２条第１号に規定する暴力団、同条第３号に規定する暴力団員等若しくは同条第２号に規定する暴力団員ではないが、暴力団と関係を有しながら、その組織の威力を背景として暴力団員による不当な行為の防止等に関する法律（平成３年法律第77号）第２条第１号に規定する暴力的不法行為等を行う者（以下「暴力団等」という。）が経営し、又は経営に実質的に関与している者

items.text_en: Is run or substantially influenced by a person who damaged trust in Wakayama's bidding system with false rumors or fraud (h).

items.text_en: Less than 1 year has passed since becoming a person under g or h (i).

provenance.review_note: One item per condition. Polarity follows the text: 2(1) ア and イ describe the bad state with no negation, so disqualification; 2(2) to 2(9) keep the negation or are plain duties, so requirement (candidates A and B had the two petition items as disqualification, the inconsistent form). The ただし exceptions p2_s5, p2_s8 and p2_s10 stay inside their own items. The 暴力団 list in 2(10) is split into its nine sub-items ア to ケ (p2_s18, p3_s1 to p3_s8), each citing the lead sentence p2_s17; B's citations p2_s19 to p2_s26 do not exist, the real ids are p3_s1 to p3_s8.

p6_s6 is about Wakayama Prefecture's own bidder register (和歌山県役務の提供等の契約に係る入札参加資格), not the national unified qualification (全省庁統一資格). The notice names no grades or category of the unified qualification, so absent; B quoted 「役務の提供等」 from the prefecture register.

accepted A; Deadlines that bidders must meet: questions due 2026-09-04 17:00 (p3_s11, p4_s12), participation documents due 2026-09-11 17:00 (p3_s13, p5_s9), proposal documents due 2026-09-18 17:00 (p3_s14, p6_s21). B adds schedule steps that are not deadlines (announcement, committee, contract, start, finish) and has two items with month-only dates that fail the schema. The answer-by date 09-10 is the office's own date, not a bidder deadline, so left out.
